copyDebugInfoToClipboard() used a non-null assertion on the intent extra,
which threw an uncaught NullPointerException if the clip_data extra was
missing. IntentHandler is exported with no permission requirement, so
any app could trigger this.

Fixes #21630

head_commit.message:
Fix IntentHandler crash on COPY_DEBUG_INFO without clip_data extra

copyDebugInfoToClipboard() used a non-null assertion on the intent extra,
which threw an uncaught NullPointerException if the clip_data extra was
missing. IntentHandler is exported with no permission requirement, so
any app could trigger this.

Fixes #21630
